_about: Every outside source the skier and snowboarder models use, with its licence. The models themselves are built by script in skierkit/ and are ours. Only CC0 sources are allowed (owner, 2026-11-12); the audit fails on any other licence.

sources.name: MakeHuman base mesh hm08 and its game-engine rig
sources.use: Bone lengths and joint heights of a 1.75 m adult (skierkit/skeleton.py). No mesh, texture or weight data is copied.
sources.note: The base mesh file states it was released as CC0 in September 2020. The MPFB add-on itself is GPL v3; it is a tool and nothing of it ships.

notUsed.name: Mixamo
notUsed.why: not CC0; raw files may not be redistributed

notUsed.name: CMU motion capture
notUsed.why: free to use but not CC0, and it has no skiing

motion: All clips are keyed by script in skierkit/clips.py; no motion capture is used.
